name: sovereign_optimize_context
description: Pre-filters large archives down to verified evidence chunks with citations. Cuts prompt tokens by 90%+ (guaranteed >= 40%) in a single call, eliminating cloud token waste.

confidence_floor.description: Minimum RRF score threshold to discard low-confidence noise

evidence_grounding.description: Executive knob 2: Evidence citation & grounding posture

include_graph_dossier.description: Attach relational knowledge graph entities and links to results

include_visual_plates.description: Executive knob 3: Include visual diagram/table plates

max_chunks.description: Maximum number of verified evidence chunks to include (1 to 10)

query.description: The query or topic to retrieve and optimize context for

retrieval_mode.description: Tuning mode: 'high_precision' (strict top chunks, max compression), 'legal_discovery' (broad recall, exhibits review), or 'exact_entity' (lexical BM25 priority for tax IDs/contracts)

user_clearance.description: Executive knob 4: MAC user security clearance level
